about: WMI health: the namespaces the check probes, each with what it is for, a one-row read-only WQL probe and what its absence means; the WMI error codes it decodes; and the events it reads from the last event_days days. repository_limit_gb is the WMI repository size Microsoft documents as the limit, a finding from 90% of it; slow_probe_ms is the probe time above which a namespace is a finding. An error marked routine is an everyday WMI client outcome: its WMI-Activity events are listed as Routine, not as a finding.

namespaces.why: The operating system, disks, services and processes, which Veeam reads on every Windows machine it works with.
namespaces.absent_means: Every Windows machine has this namespace. Without it the WMI repository is damaged.

namespaces.why: Data that drivers publish, such as network adapter and storage driver status.
namespaces.absent_means: Every Windows machine has this namespace. Without it the WMI repository is damaged.

namespaces.why: Network adapters, addresses and firewall rules, as the NetAdapter and NetTCPIP PowerShell modules read them.
namespaces.absent_means: Windows 8 and Windows Server 2012 and later have this namespace; an earlier Windows does not.

namespaces.why: Disks, partitions and volumes, as the Storage PowerShell module reads them.
namespaces.absent_means: Windows 8 and Windows Server 2012 and later have this namespace; an earlier Windows does not.

namespaces.why: VM enumeration and control by Veeam Backup & Replication on a Hyper-V host.
namespaces.probe: SELECT Name FROM Msvm_ComputerSystem WHERE Caption = 'Hosting Computer System'
namespaces.absent_means: The Hyper-V role is not installed.

namespaces.why: The cluster, its nodes and resources, which Veeam reads to back up a failover cluster.
namespaces.absent_means: The Failover Clustering feature is not installed.

namespaces.why: The BitLocker state of each volume.

errors.name: WBEM_E_ACCESS_DENIED
errors.meaning: This account is not allowed to do that in WMI.

errors.name: WBEM_E_INVALID_CLASS
errors.meaning: The class does not exist in this namespace.

errors.name: WBEM_E_INVALID_NAMESPACE
errors.meaning: The namespace is not on the machine.

errors.name: WBEM_E_INITIALIZATION_FAILURE
errors.meaning: A WMI component failed to start.

errors.name: WBEM_E_TRANSPORT_FAILURE
errors.meaning: A network error stopped the WMI call.

errors.name: WBEM_E_CALL_CANCELLED
errors.meaning: The caller stopped reading the result set.

errors.name: WBEM_E_OUT_OF_DISK_SPACE
errors.meaning: The disk is full or the repository reached its 4 GB limit.

errors.name: WBEM_E_LOCAL_CREDENTIALS
errors.meaning: An account was given for this machine. WMI signs in on this machine as the account SAT runs as.

errors.name: WBEM_E_QUOTA_VIOLATION
errors.meaning: WMI is using too much memory.

errors.name: WBEM_E_PROVIDER_TIMED_OUT
errors.meaning: A provider did not answer in time.

errors.name: RPC_S_SERVER_UNAVAILABLE
errors.meaning: The RPC server is unavailable: the machine is down, WMI is stopped, or the ports are blocked.

errors.name: WBEM_E_NOT_FOUND
errors.meaning: The object asked for was not found.

errors.name: WBEM_E_NOT_SUPPORTED
errors.meaning: The provider does not support the operation asked for.

errors.name: WBEM_E_INVALID_OBJECT
errors.meaning: The object is not valid, such as an instance without its key properties.

errors.name: WBEM_E_ALREADY_EXISTS
errors.meaning: The object to create already exists.

events.meaning: WMI stopped a provider host (WmiPrvSE.exe) because it reached a quota, such as its handle, memory or thread limit.
A WMI operation failed. ResultCode is its error and ClientProcessId the process that asked.
